name: kalpana-batch
description: Fill your Kalpana templates from a list or spreadsheet and render personalized banners, ads, listing images and videos in bulk, after checking every row.

interface.longDescription: Kalpana Batch turns a list or spreadsheet into personalized marketing images and videos: one finished banner, ad or listing image per row, from your Kalpana templates. Find a template, turn your data into checked rows, create a draft batch, render it once you approve, and fetch the finished files. One connection covers one workspace, within your role there.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Kalpana batches and their status.
Find a Kalpana template for my next campaign.
Fill the summer banner for these three products and show me a preview.
